fullPassage: Work stress has increased significantly over the past two decades, a development mostly driven by an intensification of psychological job demands. In a comparable trend, the psychological demands surrounding training and competition in sport have increased, and these demands will likely only increase further. Maintaining the delicate balance between stress and recovery is essential for individuals to achieve optimal health, well-being, and performance. In contrast, insufficient recovery from the demands of work or sport can lead to prolonged stress reactions and chronic strain, which can ultimately lead to diverse negative outcomes. For example, employees are at risk of occupational burnout, lower productivity, a higher rate of sickness absence, and an earlier exit from the labour force. To reduce stress, many companies have introduced in-house yoga programs and flexible working hours for their employees. Likewise, potential consequences of prolonged stress and chronic strain for athletes are underrecovery, overtraining syndrome, decreased performance, and ill-health.

questions.stem:
주어진 문장들을 글의 흐름에 맞게 배열한 것은?

(A) Maintaining the delicate balance between stress and recovery is essential for individuals to achieve optimal health.
(B) Work stress has increased significantly over the past two decades.
(C) In a comparable trend, the psychological demands in sport have increased as well.

det.korean: B(업무 스트레스 증가) → C(스포츠도 유사) → A(균형 필수).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ (B)-(C)-(A): (B) 업무 스트레스 증가 → (C) 스포츠에서도 유사 → (A) 균형 유지 필수.
❌ ① (A)-(B)-(C): 결론이 먼저.
❌ ② (C)-(B)-(A): 스포츠가 업무보다 먼저.
❌ ④ (B)-(A)-(C): 균형이 스포츠 설명보다 먼저.
det.tip: 업무 → 스포츠 유사 → 대응 필요.

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② 업무 스트레스는 지난 20년간 상당히 증가했다: 원문 일치.
❌ ① 스포츠에서의 심리적 요구는 감소하고 있다: 증가.
❌ ③ 스트레스와 회복의 균형은 불필요하다: essential.
❌ ④ 만성적 스트레스는 긍정적 결과를 가져온다: negative outcomes.
det.tip: increased significantly over the past two decades.

questions.passage: Work stress has increased significantly over the past two decades, a development mostly driven by an intensification of psychological job demands. In a comparable trend, the psychological demands surrounding training and competition in sport have increased, and these demands will likely only increase further. Maintaining the delicate balance between stress and recovery is essential for individuals to achieve optimal health, well-being, and performance. In contrast, insufficient recovery from the demands of work or sport can lead to prolonged stress reactions and chronic strain, which can ultimately lead to diverse negative outcomes. For example, employees are at risk of occupational burnout, lower productivity, a higher rate of sickness absence, and an earlier exit from the labour force. To reduce stress, many companies have introduced in-house yoga programs and flexible working hours for their employees. Likewise, potential consequences of prolonged stress and chronic strain for athletes are underrecovery, overtraining syndrome, decreased performance, and ill-health.
questions.stem: 위 글에서 추론할 수 있는 것은?

det.korean: 현대 사회에서 스트레스 관리와 회복이 점점 더 중요해지고 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 현대 사회에서 스트레스 관리와 회복이 점점 더 중요해지고 있다: 증가하는 요구 + 균형 필수 + 회사 대응.
❌ ① 요가는 스트레스를 완전히 해결한다: 본문에 없음.
❌ ② 운동선수는 스트레스에 면역이 있다: 부정적 결과 나열.
❌ ③ 업무 스트레스는 앞으로 감소할 것이다: 증가 추세.
det.tip: 증가하는 요구 + essential balance + 회사 대응 = 중요성 증가.

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 직원들에게 스트레스의 부정적 결과는 없다 — 불일치.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 업무 스트레스 증가는 심리적 직무 요구의 심화에 의해 주도되었다: 일치.
❌ ② 불충분한 회복은 만성적 긴장을 초래할 수 있다: 일치.
✅ ③ 직원들에게 스트레스의 부정적 결과는 없다: burnout, lower productivity 등. 불일치.
❌ ④ 운동선수는 과훈련 증후군의 위험이 있다: 일치.
det.tip: employees: burnout, lower productivity, sickness absence, earlier exit.

questions.passage: The __________ (intense) of psychological demands has driven the increase in work stress over the past two decades.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (   ) 쓰시오. (1단어)
[intense] (영어로)
accept: intensification
Intensification
intensification.

det.analysis: 빈칸 앞에 관사 The가 있고 뒤에 전치사 of가 이어지므로 명사가 필요. intense(형용사) → intensification(명사). 'The intensification of psychological demands'.
det.tip: intense(강렬한) → intensity(강도) / intensification(심화).

questions.passage: Employees face __________ (occupy) burnout when recovery from stress is insufficient.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (   ) 쓰시오. (1단어)
[occupy] (영어로)
accept: occupational
Occupational
occupational.

det.analysis: 빈칸 뒤에 명사 burnout이 있으므로 형용사가 필요. occupy(동사) → occupational(형용사). occupational burnout = 직업적 번아웃.
det.tip: occupy(차지하다) → occupation(직업) → occupational(직업의).
